 ABANTE TONITE

 October 21, 2026 
 ABANTE-BILYONARYO GROUP, Kilalanin! 
 Sighted si Alden Richards sa closet party ni Heart Evangelista kamakailan.
 Todong na-appreciate naman ng kibitzers ang pagiging supportive ni Tisoy sa naturang ganap ni Heart.
 Marami rin ang nakapansin sa kanilang kakaibang chemistry kaya may mga humihirit na mag-collab sila sa isang project.
 Ito ang ilan sa kanilang mga komento.
 “Oh, they have chemistry, just give it a try . A Korean adaptation?”
 “Shet they look good together!!!”
 “mom’s smile was so bright when Alden was around.. you can really feel the genuine friendship!! ”
 “Alden looks even more handsome!!!”
 “heart is really someone who knows how to get along and makes every event more enjoyable”
 “They make quite the love team haha”
 “We can also do no love team projects, maybe a good variety show about art? ”
 “Siguro short series bagay sila”
 “I know may age gap pero may chemistry silaaa!”
 “I love Alden! He’s so kind hearted like Heart genuine na tao”
 “Same here! They should definitely do a project together!”
 “They are good friends plus colleagues na for a long time same network. Of course hindi impossible ang projects”
 “That’s what I appreciate about Alden.Mabait at matulungin siya. He really goes out of his way to help.Madalas nag-isponsor din siya ng block screenings for his friends.”
